title: Log-mel keyword spotting

paper.title: Speech Commands: A Dataset for Limited-Vocabulary Speech Recognition
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Log-mel keyword spotting: classify Speech Commands with a log-mel CNN using speaker-disjoint published splits. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use speech-commands; required output: Waveform or log-mel frames -> command logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Published speaker-disjoint splits; train-only normalization and silence handling. Required ablation: Replace log-mel features with linear-magnitude spectra at equal frame resolution. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
